text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that uses land-use modeling (via the AEZ model) as one component within an integrated CLEWS framework focused primarily on energy system analysis for Mauritius. While it includes future land-use changes (e.g., shifting from sugarcane to alternative crops for ethanol production) under multiple scenarios and operates at the national scale of Mauritius, land-use change is not the primary research objective. Instead, LULC dynamics serve as inputs to assess energy-water-agriculture interdependencies. The study does not present mapped LULC projections nor report quantitative accuracy metrics for land-use predictions; land-use outputs are used functionally (e.g., to derive irrigation or bioenergy potential) rather than being evaluated as predictive spatial models themselves.)
